The main T-041 (cross-tenant prefix-cache sharing) question is tenant scoping. The Gemma prefix text (lines 4145-4152) does not mention per-tenant partitions. By contrast, the GLM TP text explicitly cites prefixScope/prefixDiskScope tenant partitions (line 4248). The Gemma text only links prefix-cache.md#gemma-tp-prompt-prefixes. If it does not, cross-account reuse and timing leaks (T-041/SEC-035) would widen.

This is documentation of foreign source, not observed code. I therefore record it as an integration question rather than a finding. The next pass should check Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix and prefix-cache.md for partition scoping, and whether a cache-off request is kept out of other tenants' boundaries.
